notes.title: Patch note updates for 10/26/23 - v1.5
notes.notes:
Sandy's Great Escape is 1 week old!  Thank you to all our players, the community reception has been wonderful so far.  
Just a small patch...

[h1] Level Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Various decoration / tileset visual fixes.
[/list]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added achievement descriptions under achievement skin names in the skin select menu.
[/list]
[h1]Other / Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Achievement pop-ups last slightly longer now.
[*] Fixed bug where Achievements would not trigger if Steam overlay was disabled.
[*] Fixed bug where the rewind effect wouldn’t show when using the UI rewind button.
[*] Fixed order of dictionary entries.
[*] Now hiding mouse when using keyboard or gamepad controls.
[*] Fixed bug where Sandy could bump into invisible objects when sliding ladders on ice.
[/list]

notes.title: Small post-launch bug fix (Evil Sandy de-sync)
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that could cause you to easily de-sync Evil Sandy's movements.

notes.title: Launch Day Quick Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented the "Best" move score from updating if the player already achieved 3 coins in a level.

notes.title: Demo Update v1.3
notes.notes:
Hi crab friends!

We've made a few minor updates to the demo, mainly regarding save data and bug fixes.

[h1]Sandy's Great Escape - DEMO[/h1]
[h2]Patch Notes - Version 1.3[/h2]
[h3]October 12th, 2023[/h3]

[h2]Level changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various decoration fixes
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
 [list]
[*] Made it tougher to accidentally delete save data, including extra confirmation and holding button requirement.
[*] Steam cloud sync files should now work across different OS.
[*] Backup saves are now kept and accessible. 
[/list]

[h2]
Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where rumble level wasn’t changeable in full screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause you to rewind a step closing out of the pause menu.
[*] Fixed audio sound FX not being effected by slider.
[*] Fixed issue with mouse not responding to button inputs when swapping between keyboard/mouse controls.
[/list]

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.2
notes.notes:
Hi all! Thank you for the continued feedback and support on the demo.

We've gone ahead and pushed a demo update with lots of changes, check out the patch notes below!

[h1]Sandy's Great Escape - DEMO[/h1]
[h2]Patch Notes - Version 1.2[/h2]
[h3]October 9th, 2023[/h3]

Level changes

[list]
[*] 1-1 Hello, Sandy! - Increased difficulty
[*] 1-2 First Steps - Increased difficulty
[*] 2-4 Crabby See Crabby Do - Decreased difficulty
[*] 2-5 Arrow to the Shell - Increased difficulty
[*] 2-9 The Right Path - Increased difficulty
[*] 2-13 Slipstreams - Increased difficulty - full level redesign
[*] 1-6 But I can’t Swim! - Minor level layout change
[*] 1-9 Conveyor Crab - Minor level layout change
[*] 1-15 Beach Hopping - Minor level layout change
[*] Minor decoration updates across several levels
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]

Controls
 [list]
[*]    Added ability to control menu options with keyboard controls, making the game fully playable without mouse.
[*]     Added R as level reset button.
[*]     Added Z as undo button.
[*] Added in gameplay option to start the camera fully zoomed out.
[*] Added in the gameplay option to control rumble level.
[*] Added rumble to more mechanics.
[*] Made end screen more celebratory on level complete.
[*] Best score is shown from the pause menu now.
[*]     Scores achieved during the SGE demo are appended with “Demo”.  Any level re-beaten in the retail version of the game will overwrite the Demo score.
[*] Updated icon for dictionary page
[*] All legendary skins (yellow names) now have unique particles and/or sound FX.
[/list]

[h2]
Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where you could dip into negative move counter when interacting with Evil Sandy.
[*] Fixed bug with camera not being able zoom out fully.
[*] Fixed bug that caused darkened zones to not be view correctly on ultrawide monitors.
[*] Various audio bug fixes.
[/list]
